text: ＊の　もっていた＊を　あずかり　＊を　しっかりと　もたせた！

structure.jp: ＊の　もっていた＊を　あずかり
structure.en: took the thing ＊ was holding, and

structure.jp: ＊を　しっかりと　もたせた！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed before a noun describes it. もっていた＊ = 'the ＊ that was being held'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる means make or let someone do it. もたせた = 'made hold'.
